description: This source file defines a custom exception class `CashierExistForTellerException` used within the teller organization module of the Fineract project. It extends a platform-specific exception class and provides specific error messaging when attempting certain operations related to tellers and cashiers.

classes.name: CashierExistForTellerException
classes.description: Custom exception thrown when a cashier is found to be associated with a teller during an operation such as deletion, indicating that the teller cannot be deleted or modified due to existing associations.

methods.name: CashierExistForTellerException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a teller ID, passing a specific error code and message to the parent exception class.
